description: This Scala source file defines the Observation class used in Apache Spark SQL for monitoring dataset metrics during operations. It includes methods for creating observations, retrieving metrics, and managing observation state.

classes.name: Observation
classes.description: Helper class to observe and collect metrics from a Dataset during its first action execution.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves observed metrics as a Scala Map, waiting for the first dataset action to complete.

methods.name: getAsJava
methods.description: Retrieves observed metrics as a Java Map, waiting for the first dataset action to complete.

methods.name: markRegistered
methods.description: Marks the Observation as registered, ensuring it is used only once with a Dataset.

methods.name: setMetricsAndNotify
methods.description: Sets the observed metrics and notifies waiting threads.

methods.name: getRowOrEmpty
methods.description: Returns the observed metrics as a Row, or None if not available.

methods.name: getRow
methods.description: Returns the observed metrics as a Row, blocking until available.
